newsitem.title: USA: Sonoco sees slightly higher Q3 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Sonoco sees slightly higher Q3 earnings.

text.p: Sonoco said Wednesday that it expects earnings for this year's third quarter to slightly exceed those for the same period last year, despite increased costs of old corrugated containers, its principal raw material.
But the company said earnings in the fourth quarter are expected to show significant improvement, reflecting improved productivity and higher volume and prices in key markets.
The company has already announced a minimum 7.5 percent increase in its industrial converted paper products, effective September 1.

Sonoco also said that its joint venture partner in the production of corrugating medium paper, Georgia-Pacific Corp, previously initiated a $40 per ton price increase for the approximate 186,000 tons of corrugating medium produced by Sonoco in the venture and the company expects another $40 per ton increase before year's end.
Sonoco is a $2.8 billion global packaging producer with nearly 300 operations on five continents serving customers in some 85 nations.
